neighbours.label: sweet baking flavours named in a recipe or dessert (maple, blueberry / blackberry, banana); also fires on some first names (Barb, Barbara, Barney, Peter), which this test leaves out
fire: For brunch we made blueberry pancakes with warm maple syrup.
The bakery's best seller is a banana walnut loaf with maple icing.
She stirred fresh blackberry jam into the maple oatmeal.
The café serves a banana blueberry smoothie every morning.
He brought a maple pecan pie and a blackberry crumble.
The recipe makes twelve blueberry muffins with a banana glaze.
Grandma's maple banana bread disappeared within minutes.
The ice cream stand offers maple walnut and blueberry swirl.
quiet: For brunch we made potato pancakes with sour cream and chives.
The bakery's best seller is a rye loaf with caraway seeds.
She stirred fresh parsley into the mushroom soup.
The café serves a spinach omelette every morning.
He brought a chicken pot pie and a green salad.
The recipe makes twelve cheese scones with a garlic butter.
Grandma's onion soup disappeared within minutes.
The deli stand offers smoked turkey and roast beef.

notes: Card: 'berry' x4, ' banana', ' Banana', ' Maple', but also ' Barb', ' Barney', ' Peter'. Probes: maple glaze 0.86, maple trees 0.28, banana bread 0.29, strawberry 0.29, vanilla 0.25, chocolate 0.20; Barb 0.56, Barbara 0.40, Peter 0.02-0.67; savoury food 0.06, Susan 0.01. A list, with no shared pattern found between the flavours and the names.
